files.html:
0.1.5. Changelog

Added

  • Added a weapon pool system with randomized weapon and skin assignment support.
  • Random assignment currently runs on the NPC init event.
  • More trigger conditions may be added in future updates.
  • Added new filtering options to the target settings, including quick filtering for hostile mobs.

Fixed

  • Fixed an issue where cloned NPCs could spawn without the correct TACZ Fire pose.
  • Fixed an issue where machine guns would not fire correctly.
